title: "Code is the Easy Part" by Evan Czaplicki
summary: Evan Czaplicki, creator of Elm, gives an elm-conf 2016 talk on the non-code side of building a language. It covers the philosophy behind Elm's development approach, including batching work and the priorities of different language communities.
why: HN points people to it to understand Elm's design philosophy, such as favoring simplicity over type classes, when they question its choices.

quote.text: great talk by Evan Czaplicki and his approach to Elm development
